facts.fact: The Akofena study (2026) says street numbering in N'Djamena began in 1990 across the first five arrondissements and was made official in 2016, but the administrative addressing system remains incomplete, leaving out the old quarters and most newly planned ones.
The Akofena study (2026) says addressing in N'Djamena is used to locate subscribers, connection points and plots to be served with water and electricity, for fiscal and urban-service reasons.
